versioning_procedure.minor_bump: Any change to rules, scan coverage, required_disclaimer.pages, route aliases, exemptions, or evidence_state requires a minor version bump and an effective_date update.
versioning_procedure.patch_bump: Allowlist-only line-number or exact-text refreshes require a patch version bump.
versioning_procedure.review: Every version change requires human review against the authority and cited evidence before release.
